title: PopBERT. Detecting populism and its host ideologies in the German Bundestag
reasoning: The paper uses an ideational definition of populism that hinges on a 'moral dichotomy' and requires the detection of 'moralizing language.' The authors specifically instructed annotators to label statements as populist only when they contained a moralizing tone, effectively evaluating and benchmarking the model's ability to identify moral judgments in political rhetoric.
